name: Solas
source:
LIKES: Nature
DISLIKES: Everything else 

A mysterious and dangerous god.

Little and less is known of him.

What is known is his anger at the world, betrayed and twisted he has turned his back on all he once stood for.

Friend or foe remains to be seen.
